explanation: This fires only at D1, and only late in the episode (about trial 86 or later): it hits 9-10 when the agent has been choosing a2 and the previous trial was rewarded, especially after two or more rewarded a2 trials in a row (the first rewarded D1 after a loss gives only about 2-5). It is 0 at every GO and D2 step, at every unrewarded D1, whenever the agent is choosing a1, and before about trial 85 (at most 1-2 around trials 67-69).
